title: Implement real compile-and-probe for synthesized reflexes (VC-201-007)
goal: VC-201-007 refuted: probe_reflex never compiles or executes the reflex — it substring-matches the source, so a reflex whose only mention of the expected action is a comment is accepted, a verbatim echo spelled 'return(input)' evades the echo check, and the malformed check rejects the fixture rather than probing the reflex's behavior. reflex_intent has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_007_mastery.rs.
